## Episode Thesis

This is an EFN Börslunch special on AI in equity analysis, investor conferences and pre-earnings calls. The guests are Adam Thelander of Quartr and analyst Björn Norlander of Murgata. It argues that AI and MCP data pipelines will change equity research more over the next 2-3 years than in the past 20, and that human contact will matter more as a result. There is no market call: the Stockholm exchange is up slightly, a short news segment covers daily movers, and nobody gives a directional view on any stock.
